scope: Real monitor_explosion_candidates.main() with actual PostgreSQL 18.6 parent SQL, tip snapshot SQL, writer CAS/transactions and independent persisted state/queue/report and database readback; no live external services, canonical Neon schema equivalence or production operation

preflight.trigger_inventory: Read WIP and research workflow trigger paths; research branch does not match operational WIP code-push triggers; no WIP push

pinned_external_read_only_contract.verification: CI downloads exact immutable ref and independently hashes Git blob bytes prior to execution

main_invocation: Import exact source module, patch its temporary fixture paths/sys.argv/UTC clock and external adapters, call mon.main() in --local-only mode; no copied main(), no SQL reader/writer mocks on positive path.

synthetic_inputs.episodes: 1 or 2 independently generated canonical IDs from actual monitor.make_episode()
synthetic_inputs.coverage: controlled synthetic persisted cached bridge and synthetic Kyiv/Sevastopol input
synthetic_inputs.database: fresh postgres:18 service on localhost; synthetic_only DSN; no production credentials
synthetic_inputs.network: requests.sessions.Session.request, urllib.request.urlopen, UkraineAlarmClient and poll_alerts fail immediately; controlled Google News/Telegram adapters return synthetic empty results; forbidden network call count zero

postgres_schema: REDUCED_SYNTHETIC_SCHEMA; original writer DDL fixture extended minimally with ingestion_runs, alert_episodes run audit fields, uniqueness, parent foreign keys. Pinned unchanged site-prod phase1 SQL/transactions executed, not mocked. NOT proven equivalent to Neon.

cases.M1: main() commits first classification/source/event with real canonical parent insertion, authoritative snapshot and JSON checkpoints
cases.M2: identical main() restart no duplicate or extra writes
cases.M3: new 24-hour due check and additional synthetic evidence append valid successor revision, one current tip
cases.M4: snapshot observed on connection A, competitor real writer committed on independent connection B; unchanged original expected tip rejected with STALE_EXPECTED_TIP; no false checkpoint
cases.M5: unavailable PG connection rejects the monitor before successful checkpoint; no absence fabricated
cases.M6: synthetic search error means incomplete coverage, no classification persisted and saved due check remains pending
cases.M7: fault after first classification insert within real writer transaction rolls back classification/source/event; previously inserted parent is independently accounted
cases.M8: two episodes selected, first commit durable, second fails inside writer transaction; no false state/queue/report checkpoint
cases.M9: actual main() restart with unchanged temp files reconciles committed first episode idempotently, commits second without duplicate
cases.M10: subsequent main() exact restart and persisted JSON readback reconcile all two classifications and source/event/parent relationships
cases.N1: mutation control replaces canonical batch call with false success; independent persisted-file/database reconciliation detects missing classification
cases.N2: mutation control corrupts saved checked_at; saved-state tip-equivalence readback detects inconsistent checkpoint
cases.N3: mutation control creates a duplicate current tip in synthetic database; independent tip integrity readback catches duplication

execution.results: M1-M10 10/10 PASS; N1-N3 3/3 PASS per run; writer T1-T24 24/24 and 3 additional regressions per run; I1-I15 15/15 per run
execution.receipts: Exact per-case JSON file SHA-256, parent/classification/source/event counts, CAS PID/tips and committed restart relationships in zipped /tmp/h2_monitor_main_report.json per independent run

limitations: The SQL fixture remains reduced synthetic schema and does not establish canonical Neon DDL equivalence
External Google News and Telegram behavior is controlled and mocked; no real publisher-source availability proof
Synthetic first/restart/followup and multi-episode scenarios are not a full 5521-entry historical queue replay
State/queue/last-run hashes and row-level trace are in 30-day Actions artifacts; durable raw archive preservation remains a separate evidence-retention concern
No explicit lost-acknowledgement-after-commit full-main fault scenario; the accepted writer T regressions separately exercise uncertain commit
Negative controls cover writer bypass, malformed JSON and duplicate current tip, but do not directly mutate monitor to silently refresh a stale tip
No operational workflow or live cutover safety proof
